title: ‘Tell Me Lies’ Creator Dives Into That Jaw-Dropping Finale and Explains Why the Show Is Ending: “We Couldn’t F*** It Up”
summary: Meaghan Oppenheimer unravels the chaotic season three and series finale that answered many questions, posed new ones for Lucy and Bree, and brought the series to a close. "I always felt like three seasons was a perfect number," she tells The Hollywood Reporter.
